subject: Annual assurance partner selection & renewal (SOC 2 / ISO)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual assurance partner selection & renewal (SOC 2 / ISO)

Team —

Time to select our assurance partner for the upcoming SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 renewal. We need a recommendation by EOD next Friday so procurement and legal can lock terms and get SOWs signed before our audit window in Q3.

Context: current partner (ClearAssurance) has done the last two cycles; we also ran an exploratory call with 45North (smaller shop, aggressive pricing). Attached is the internal requirements doc with controls scope and calendar.

Ask: please help shortlist no more than two vendors and provide a quick pros/cons + expected total cost (not just audit fee — include travel, remediation verification, and any add-on services).

Key constraints:
- Maintain continuity for audit evidence reuse where possible
- Prefer vendors who support our VPC/on-prem private deployment evidence collection (SOC logs, SIEM access)
- Minimal disruption to engineering (limited number of control walk-throughs)

Attachments: redwood-soc2-requirements.docx

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@clearassurance.com>, David Li <david.li@45north.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 renewal — timeline & requirements

Amanda / David —

Following up from Evelyn's note — attached is our requirements doc and calendar. Can each of you confirm:

1) Scope assumptions and any exclusions
2) Estimated total cost (line items: audit, travel, remediation verification, reporting)
3) Availability for the audit window (tentative: Aug 2 — Sep 15)
4) Any references for similar SaaS customers (preferably PLG / multi-tenant)

Please reply with a short proposal by EOD Thursday so we can share with the execs.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-requirements.docx

Best — Monica
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-requirements.docx]
From: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@clearassurance.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearassurance.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: ClearAssurance proposal for Redwood Inference — SOC 2 + ISO 27001 (summary)

Hi Monica / Evelyn —

Thanks for the opportunity. Quick summary of our proposal (full PDF attached):

Scope & approach:
- SOC 2 Type II (security, availability, confidentiality) + ISO 27001 gap assessment and certification support.
- Reuse of prior year working papers to reduce fieldwork by ~25% where controls unchanged.
- Remote evidence collection for control testing with 2 on-site days for leadership control interviews.

Estimated cost (fixed-fee):
- Audit fees: $86,500
- ISO assessment & advisory: $18,000
- Travel & on-site (2 days): $4,200
- Remediation verification windows (up to 2): $3,500
- Total: $112,200 (net)

Availability: we can confirm dates in August (week of Aug 9) or late August.

Differentiators: deep experience with PLG SaaS (three customers of similar size), dedicated engagement manager, and a slightly faster turnaround on report delivery (2 weeks post-fieldwork).

Next steps:
- If this aligns, we'll send a formal proposal PDF and SOW for legal review.
- We can provide client references and sample report extracts on request.

Regards,
Amanda Cole
Senior Director, Client Services
ClearAssurance LLC
[Attachment: ClearAssurance-proposal-2027.pdf]
From: David Li <david.li@45north.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 renewal — 45North proposal

Monica —

Appreciate the chance to bid. We're a smaller firm but offer a hands-on partner-led engagement. Highlights:
- Aggressive pricing: core SOC 2 Type II + ISO advisory for $72,000 total
- Remote-first testing with one optional on-site day
- Flexible scheduling to fit your engineering slates

Caveats: we have fewer PLG-specific references, but we do have strong experience with mid-market SaaS and platform infra.

I've attached a scope/estimate workbook. Happy to walk through it on a short call.

Thanks — David
Principal Consultant, 45North
[Attachment: 45North-scope-estimate.xlsx]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual assurance partner selection & renewal (SOC 2 / ISO)

Evelyn / Monica —

Quick read of proposals:
- ClearAssurance: higher cost but continuity + faster report turnaround. Familiar with our environment.
- 45North: ~35% cheaper, more flexible, potential risk on PLG experience.

My recommendation: choose ClearAssurance if leadership values continuity and lower operational lift for eng. Choose 45North if we need to cut cost this cycle and are willing to absorb more vendor management.

Two operational notes:
1) If we move to 45North we should get a written SLA on evidence collection timelines and a named engagement partner.
2) If we go with ClearAssurance, ask for a one-time implementation credit tied to reuse of prior-year artifacts.

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Security
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Legal / Commercial next steps

Team —

If we proceed with ClearAssurance, procurement needs:
- Clean SOW (scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, payment milestones)
- NDA / data handling addendum (they already signed our standard vendor NDA; confirm retention schedule)
- DocuSign for SOW + one-year renewal option clause

I've drafted a SOW skeleton (SOW-draft.docx) and popped a HubSpot deal (see link). Please confirm vendor selection so I can send to their legal and expedite DocuSign.

Marcus Lin
Head of Procurement
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Award: Assurance partner for 2027 SOC 2 / ISO renewal

Amanda —

Thanks for the thorough proposal. After internal review, Redwood will engage ClearAssurance for the 2027 SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 assessment. Key asks before we sign:
- Please confirm availability for fieldwork week of Aug 9 (or the following week if conflict)
- Accept a one-time implementation credit of $6,000 tied to reuse of prior-year artifacts (we expect a similar reduction in effort)
- Accept DocuSign SOW with a standard 30-day payment term and an option for a one-year renewal at agreed rates

Marcus will send the SOW and contract; please have legal review and confirm turnaround for signature.
